caution_findings.note: DRAMP broad Antimicrobial/Anticancer labels are wider than the local primary evidence. Table 1 supports peptide identity/formulae; opened XML/PDF/supplement text supports cell-penetrating, stability, and mammalian cytotoxicity evidence, not antimicrobial target-organism rows.
DRAMP35360 is retained as literature/database-only for this packet because no local Table 1/source row matches it and merged DRAMP rows point that source_id to a different reference.
Local text supports qualitative/no-significant-inhibition and maximum 72 h inhibition statements; exact per-cell-line bar heights were not fabricated from graph-only material.

The supplementary PDF contains methods, Table S1 kinetic activity, and Figure S8 cytotoxicity display; no spreadsheet/structured activity table was present, and supplementary_tables.json reports table_count 0.
Mechanism claims are limited to CPP membrane binding, endocytosis/endosomal escape, and cargo delivery in mammalian cells; no antimicrobial mechanism is inferred.
The generic rework ticket is closed because owner-layer blockers were repaired, but scientific cautions remain visible in final artifacts.
